name: Furiell
check: Knows what's best for you. Has forty blankets to prove it.

acts.label: Talk
acts.text: * You talk about video games. She nods. She is not listening.

acts.label: Accept Hug
acts.text: * She hugs you. It lasts a while.

spareLines: Stop looking at me like that.
...I know you want to go home, but...
Please go upstairs. I have so many blankets.
...Ha ha. I can't even keep a single gamer.
...No. You'd be unhappy down here. Even with the fursuit head.
spareOutro: * It's warm. It's VERY fluffy. It smells like lavender and fursuit.
spareText: If you truly wish to leave... I won't stop you. But please. Leave a review.
deathText: * Only a small pile of plush stuffing remains.
deathLines: You... really think I'm that cringe...?
...so you really are... just a gamer...

default: * Furiell adjusts her glitter. It does not need adjusting.
lowHp: * Furiell is breathing hard. She is still smiling.
spareable: * Furiell is waiting for you to leave.
